items.name: Triple-Core lithium production capacity target, 2033
items.claim: POSCO Holdings targets lithium production of 173,000 tons by 2033, aiming to rank among the top five global producers, as part of the Triple-Core portfolio strategy unveiled at its CEO Investor Day.
items.source_excerpt: The group plans a “Triple-Core” portfolio built around Industrial, Strategic and Energy Resources, targeting overseas crude steel capacity of 10 million tons by 2031, lithium production of 173,000 tons by 2033 to rank among the top five global producers, and a broader footprint in rare earths, specialty gases, LNG and renewable energy.

notes: Stored 6-K (0001193125-26-375277) contains extensive contract-related text (16 'contract' hits) that on inspection is boilerplate legal/risk-factor language, not named awards, so none of it qualified as a CONTRACT item. The Globe and Mail syndicated release on POSCO's 2026-07-02 CEO Investor Day (stored HTTP 200) supplies the one quantified, dated forward capacity target used above; currency left null since the value is a tonnage target, not a monetary figure. The release also cites a 10-million-ton overseas crude steel capacity target by 2031 and 2028 financial goals (KRW 87.9tn revenue, KRW 6.7tn operating profit) which are financial targets rather than backlog/contract/product/project pipeline items under method section 6B and were left out.
